verdict.rationale: dlt ships an official CLI documented at dlthub.com/docs/reference/command-line-interface for creating, adding, inspecting and deploying pipelines, and a runtime probe confirms it installs keylessly via uvx and runs (`dlt 1.30.0`), plus a live `dlt init` scaffold succeeded end-to-end. It's explicitly positioned for AI-native workflows via the dltHub AI Harness/MCP server that teaches coding agents to use dlt pipelines. Missing for 10: independent (non-vendor) hands-on review specifically of the CLI's AI-native ergonomics.
